animal rendered in low relief on a flat face

justification: Both are pale limestone uprights bearing schematic animals arranged vertically on one face, with the most specific correspondence being a boldly projecting, near three-dimensional animal in the upper zone sitting above a flatter, shallow-relief quadruped shown in profile with splayed legs and tail. The biggest difference is density and organisation: B is a crowded, register-like composition of many small low-relief creatures topped by a horizontal patterned band on a broad T-shaped head, whereas A is sparse, with only two isolated figures and a far more sculptural, rounded modelling of the upper animal.
